title: Åland University of Applied Sciences Library - Högskolebiblioteket

The Åland University of Applied Sciences Library is located within the Mariehamn City Library and provides services to both students and faculty of the university.
All students at the Åland University of Applied Sciences have access to the library, which has a wide selection of books, databases, journals etc. Mariehamn City Library is an attractive and spacious building in a central location with staff who provide high-quality service. Much of the course material for the university’s different degree programmes can be found in the extensive library collection. Students also have access to computers and other library services, such as interlibrary loans and study rooms.
If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us, either by telephone +358 (0)18 53 7707, +358 (0)18 53 7706 or by e-mail bibliotek@ha.ax .
Visit the library The Mariehamn City Library which contains the Åland University of Applied Sciences Library is located in the central part of Mariehamn. Visiting address Strandgatan 29, Mariehamn Map over Mariehamn


### Visiting address

Electronic Resources The Åland Universtity Library gives the students and faculty access to a variety of databases. HÅ’s Discovery Service Search all of the library’s electronic resources using one single search box bibliotek.ax bibliotek.ax is the Union Catalogue of the Ålands Islands libraries, including Åland University Library and Mariehamn City Library LIBRIS LIBRIS is the National Union Catalogue of the Swedish academic and research libraries Finna.fi A search service for finding material from Finnish archives, libraries, museums and other organisations. Ebook Central Ebook Central provides tens of thousands of non-fiction ebooks, mostly in English. User guide: Ebook Central Libguide EBSCOhost EBSCOhost databases including Academic Search Premier, Engineering Source, Hospitality & Tourism Complete and CINAHL Complete. IEEE Xplore IEEE Xplore provides access to more than five million full-text documents from publications in electrical engineering, computer science, and electronics. ProQuest ProQuest ABI/INFORM is a business database with over 3,700 journals and 14,000 ProQuest business dissertations. The database contains over 2,800 full-text titles covering business and economic conditions, corporate strategies, management techniques, as well as competitive and product information. ScienceDirect Interdisciplinary database with publications from Elsevier. The articles are ordered through the library. Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ) Free, full text, quality controlled scientific and scholarly journals, covering all subjects and many languages. MOT Dictionaries MOT offers a variety of dictionaries, for example Swedish-English-Swedish Dictionary.
